entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Add a `dotnetup dotnet` command to forward to the user-local install root. That way if the PATH isn't correct but `dotnetup` is on the path you still have a way to access the user-local dotnet. (For this to be more useful, we need to have a way of installing dotnetup itself and adding dotnetup to the path). #52122
  • dotnetup: Set up installed dotnet install root as default #52121
  • dotnet watch ignores StaticWebAssetPath metadata on @(Watch) items, preventing custom static file hot reload #52119
  • [dotnet-watch] Improve output when top-level code is updated #52116
  • Can't disable timeline view on `dotnet test` with MTP #52114
  • APICompat doesn't catch when a member changes static #52111
  • .NET 10 SDK dotnet clean does not remove packages produced by multi-TFM projects #52109
  • Passing a filename as an argument using the `dotnet App.cs` command isn’t working. #52108
    10.0.2xx
  • `dotnet test` mtp exit code is confusing #52107
  • `dotnet test` mtp is buggy with platforms #52106
  • Slower build times with SDK 10 compared to 8 #52105
  • .NET SDK contains outdated vulnerable components (Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Core, System.Formats.Asn1) Body: #52104
  • Publish failure caused by targeting win-arm64 on a 64-bit OS for a .NET 11 WinForms/WPF Project #52103
  • The "Learn more" link navigates to blank page in the installer page #52094

Closed

  • Rename the dnup CLI to dotnetup #51576
  • dotnet ignores http proxy set via mono nuget.exe and can't build solution with mono nuget.exe #14456
  • [Hot Reload][Unstable] Some warnings "Expected to find a static method 'ClearCache', 'UpdateApplication' or 'UpdateContent'..." appear after saving the code snippets changes in .cs/.razor files of Windows Forms/WPF App in dotnet watch #51480
  • `error MSB3073: The command "dotnet "microsoft.extensions.apidescription.server/10.0.0/build/../tools/dotnet-getdocument.dll" exited with code 11` #52102

PullRequests

Created

  • Move definitions to Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.Definitions #52120
  • [dotnet-run] fix logging and `Restore` for device selection #52113
  • Add APICompat rule to detect static keyword changes on members and types #52112
  • Avoid discarding file-like arguments in `dotnet file.cs` invocations #52110
    Area-run-file
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52096
    Area-VMR

Updated

  • [release/10.0.2xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52038
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52028
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-NuGet, Area-AspNetCore
  • Virtual project builder #52030
  • Fix muxer version handling to use runtime versions instead of SDK versions #51971
  • Add LoadPrunePackageDataFromNearestFramework parameter for building against newer TFMs #51978
  • Add trailing slash for -o Fixes #45682 #48640
    untriaged, Area-CLI, stale
  • Fix dotnet-run-file up-to-date checks across symlinks #52064
    Area-run-file
  • [dotnet-run] Implement `DeployToDevice` target invocation #52046
  • CLI --self-contained description is wrong #51088
  • Add warnings for newer tool versions during `dotnet tool restore` #51011
  • Add GitHub Actions workflows to automate XLF updates and completion test fixes #51158
  • Fix: Unsupported maccatalyst attribute is getting applied to child attributes but not accounted parent child attributes merge #50334
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Make the toolsResolverCache path overridable using an environment variable. Fixes #11432. #43576
    Area-Infrastructure, untriaged, Document for new feature
  • Add support for creating and editing solution filter (.slnf) files from the CLI #51156
  • Fix CA1034 diagnostic when extension members are present #51773
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Add Executable launch profile support to dotnet run and dotnet watch #51727
    Partner request, Document for new feature, Area-Run, 10.0.2xx
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #52022
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'main' #52027
  • Fix duplicate versions in `dotnet workload search version` when multiple feeds contain same version #50980
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.3xx' => 'release/8.0.4xx' #52083
    Branch Lockdown
  • Fix: Allow --version option with workload restore #52048
